title: Intel Advances US Factory Expansion as Chip Demand Grows
gist: Intel is installing equipment at Fab 62 on its Ocotillo, Arizona campus with operations targeted by end-2028, and has placed the first major truss at its New Albany, Ohio site. Because CEO Lip-Bu Tan ties expansion to customer demand, the post reads the progress as a sign of stronger expected demand, while cautioning that not every future line has customers.
